title: Widening to 2-Lane with Paved Shoulders – NH-150A
location: NH-150A, Venkateshwara Camp to Dadesugur Camp, Karnataka
description: Widening of NH-150A from Km 184.70 to Km 198.92 to a 2-lane carriageway with paved shoulders under EPC mode, covering the Venkateshwara Camp to Dadesugur Camp section under NH(O) Annual Plan 2022-23.
